chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan narrated to me, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Ghiyath from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti, who said:
I read the letter of Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him): 'Convey to my Shias that my Ziyarat equals in the sight of Allah one thousand Hajjs thousand Hajjs.'
He said: I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), 'One thousand Hajjs?' He replied, 'Yes, by Allah, and one thousand [more], for whoever visits him knowing his right.'
Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: 'Whoever visits one of us is like the one who visited al-Husayn (peace be upon him).'

key_terms.الصَّادِق: Al-Sadiq (the Truthful, title of Imam Ja'far)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing Ziyarat of the Imams according to Imam al-Rida and Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Thawab al-A'mal*, this hadith highlights the concept of *al-'irfan bi-haqqihi* (knowing the Imam's rights) as the key condition for attaining the reward of a thousand Hajjs, reflecting the Shia emphasis on spiritual recognition over mere physical presence. It further establishes the theological principle of the spiritual unity of the Imams, where visiting any one of them is equivalent to visiting Imam al-Husayn (a.s.), underscoring his preeminent status in the lineage of Ahl al-Bayt.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 3. It was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan who said it was narrated to us by Muhammad b. al-Hassan al-Saffar from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Ghiyath from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Abi Nasr al-Bazanti who said:
It is narrated that a letter of Imam Ridha (a.s.) contained the following text: “Convey to my Shias that the reward of my Ziyarat equals to one thousand Hajjs.”
The narrator asked Imam Jawad (a.s.), “Is it equal to a thousand Hajjs?” Imam (a.s.) replied, “Yes, one who performs his Ziyarat knowing his right this act is equal to a million Hajjs.”
Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) says that one who performs the Ziyarat of any one of us will get the reward of the Ziyarat of Imam Husain (a.s.).”
